summary: slurp options: armor (base64 encode, default true, added 2.21) and the required src file path.
questions: Can slurp return plain text instead of base64?

answer_card.title: slurp parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `src` (required, alias `path`): a file, not a directory
- `armor` (true, 2.21+): base64-encode; set `false` to get UTF-8 text (risky for binary/non-UTF-8)
